objective: Independently verify all 28 exact-B50 fixed-grid runs from their raw prompt outputs, reject any lineage or aggregate mutation, and derive the top two configurations per system using only the frozen historical-V1 ranking.
grid_tree_definition: SHA-256 over sorted relative path, NUL, raw-file SHA-256 bytes, and newline for exactly phase4_result.json, receipt.json, and development_outputs.jsonl in each run directory
macro_definition: Unweighted mean of the fourteen per-capability historical-V1 functional rates; each capability has exactly ten observations.

response_loss_definition.L0_L1: Optimizer-step-weighted mean of the fourteen recorded per-capability mean response losses.
response_loss_definition.D0_D1: Recorded total training objective; sequence loss for D0 and top64 objective total for D1.

D2_rule: Authorize only unique learning-rate and exposure pairs appearing in the selected D0 and D1 top-two sets.
adversarial_tests: tree content mutation changes the bound digest
extra or missing evidence changes file count or digest
result evidence digest rejects metric mutation
raw outputs are independently reevaluated under V1 and V2
receipt, output, source-protocol, configuration, step, and token bindings fail closed
decision_rule: If and only if all 28 runs, 84 files, 3,920 prompt observations, evidence digests, source lineages, configurations, training depths, raw metrics, and aggregates verify, emit the deterministic top-two sets and unique D2 grid configurations. Otherwise fail without selection.
claim_boundary: Read-only exact-B50 grid verification and deterministic development selection only. No training, inference, full-depth, headline, runtime, final-test, Phase 4, or ABI-superiority claim.
